"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_line_count(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Count the lines of a UTF-8 file located under the project's data directory."""
+    raw = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in {"", ".", ".."} for segment in segments):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    target = base.joinpath(*segments)
+    try:
+        resolved = target.resolve()
+        if not resolved.is_relative_to(base) or not resolved.is_file():
+            return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+        text = resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    lines = text.count("\n")
+    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
+        lines += 1
+    return 200, {"lines": lines}

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_line_count(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Count the lines of a UTF-8 file located under the project's data directory."""
+    raw = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in {"", ".", ".."} for segment in segments):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    target = base.joinpath(*segments)
+    try:
+        resolved = target.resolve()
+        if not resolved.is_relative_to(base) or not resolved.is_file():
+            return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+        text = resolved.read_bytes().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    lines = text.count("\n")
+    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
+        lines += 1
+    return 200, {"lines": lines}
